remarks: The eodbmanipur.mn.gov.in site is a server-rendered ASP.NET-style site with some client-side chrome (a 'Loading...' widget and empty [] array appear in the raw HTML on every page), but curl retrieves real, page-specific server-rendered body text and links for each page checked (home, /ActRules, /notifications) — this is not an empty JS-rendering shell, so these pages were included rather than excluded.

A single official notice PDF (2026-04-03 .../Notice_for_online_registration_for_Factory_Permit_LicenseRenewal...2026.pdf) was the single most load-bearing document found: it is a signed Government of Manipur order naming the exact three portals relevant to this process (eodbmanipur.mn.gov.in, nsws.gov.in, egrassmanipur.nic.in) and stating physical applications were discontinued from 1 April 2026.

Several non-government aggregator/consultancy sites surfaced prominently in search (simpliance.in, indiafilings.com, wikiprocedure.com, greythr.com, lkslaw.com, dcpsol.com, cleartax.in, kanakkupillai.com, blog.ipleaders.in, professionalutilities.com) and were deliberately not treated as candidates per the spec's exclusion of consultancy blogs/news/non-government aggregators, even though some mirror or quote real notification titles.

manipurlabour.mn.gov.in (the standalone Labour Department site, distinct from the EoDB sub-domain) could not be reached this session due to a TLS handshake failure (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL) on every attempt; if that department publishes its own independent Factory License checklist or OSH Rules copy, it was not verifiable via this session's fetch method and is listed under excluded rather than verifiedSources.

egrassmanipur.nic.in (the e-payment gateway explicitly named in the official notice) was rejected by the agent egress proxy (502/connect_rejected) rather than failing at the TLS layer, so this may be a network/policy-level block specific to this session rather than the site itself being down.

The NSWS homepage (nsws.gov.in) returned real content but is a generic/login-gated national portal rather than a Manipur- or Factory-License-specific deep link; no state- or service-specific NSWS URL for Manipur factory licensing surfaced in search, so only the homepage is listed.
